name: Trip n Go
source:
A short SFW Visual Novel to tell a story about a gay couple who going for a trip to a mountain, witness the most simple and wholesome interactions from their lovely relationship!

[From [url=https://catasskebab.itch.io/trip-n-go]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部全年龄向短篇视觉小说，讲述一对男同性恋情侣的登山之旅，展现他们最平凡而温馨的相处点滴！

[来源：[url=https://catasskebab.itch.io/trip-n-go]Itch.io[/url]]
